reviewer_reasoning: Address and phone are confirmed by two independent sources (org website lists 1215 East 4th Street as Southeast Regional Distribution Center; Laurel County Health Dept resource guide lists same address with 606-862-6693 and Mon-Fri 7:00 AM-3:30 PM hours). However, the org itself labels this location a 'warehouse' under 'Warehouse locations,' and it's unclear whether individuals can receive food directly there or only partner agencies — this determines approve vs. reject.
guidance: Check godspantry.org's 'Find Food' tool (findfood.godspantry.org or similar) to see if 1215 E 4th St London appears as a direct-service pantry location or only as a warehouse. Also check the Facebook page 'God's Pantry Food Bank of Southeast Kentucky' (facebook.com/foodbanksoutheastky) for posts about public distributions/hours at the London site, and call 606-862-6693 to ask whether individuals can pick up food on-site or are referred to partner pantries. If it's agency-only, reject as not public-facing; if walk-in distribution exists, approve with hours Mon-Fri 7:00 AM-3:30 PM.
questions_to_answer: Does the London 1215 E 4th St location distribute food directly to individuals/families, or only to partner agencies/pantries?
Are the hours Monday-Friday 7:00 AM-3:30 PM (per Laurel County Health Dept) current and accurate for public access?
Is there a separate public-facing pantry or distribution site in London operated by God's Pantry for walk-in clients?
